
{{alias}}( arr, names, fields )
    Converts the columns of a two-dimensional ndarray to "tidy" data sets.

    The list of field names should be a two-element array where the first
    element corresponds to the field name of the row index and the second
    element corresponds to the field name of the column element value.

    Parameters
    ----------
    arr: ndarray
        Input ndarray.

    names: Array<string>
        Data set (column) names.

    fields: Array<string>
        List of field names.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Array<DataSet>
        Array of data sets.

    Examples
    --------
    > var opts = { 'shape': [ 2, 2 ] };
    > var x = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/array}}( [ 1, 2, 3, 4 ], opts );
    > var out = {{alias}}( x, [ 'series1', 'series2' ], [ 'index', 'value' ] )
    [ <DataSet>, <DataSet> ]

    See Also
    --------
